entry.summary: To use presigned URLs for uploading AI-generated images, let your backend authorize a short-lived upload and let the client send the bytes directly to object storage. entry.title: A Privacy Policy is a promise. Zero-knowledge is a property.
entry.summary: Why we built a team workspace around one question: what does a fully compromised server learn? Most “private” workspace tools protect your data with a promise. The promise lives in a privacy policy: we will not look, we will not sell, we will not share. It may be sincere. entry.summary:
Big O Notation
Vamos logo falar da notação que vai nos acompanhar a carreira inteira. Big O é uma forma de denotar o desempenho de um algoritmo, levando sempre em consideração o pior dos casos. Porém, Big O leva em consideração a escalabilidade e a execução. Por exemplo, O(n) é melhor que O(n²), mas, sem a análise assintótica, não podemos afirmar com total certeza. entry.title: php2shell on a dead distro: rebuilding patched PHP for Debian 9 and 8
entry.summary: On 21 October 2026 the PHP project fixed two critical bugs, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, quickly nicknamed php2shell. Both can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. In the first, an out-of-memory error can interrupt PHP while internal request data is only partially initialized; request parsing is the easiest way to get there, but not the only one. In the second, request-owned state survives in a persistent worker after its memory has been freed. Full RCE was demonstrated on Apache mod_php; on PHP-FPM the exposure is more limited and depends on the configuration, but "limited" is not "safe". The fixed releases were 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12, and the PHP project published minimal source backports for 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1. Anything older depends on distributions and LTS pro…
